config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.description: Base URL every GBIF API request is built from. Override to route through a proxy or a mirror of the GBIF v1 API.

config.label: Milliseconds a single GBIF API request may take before it is aborted
config.description: Milliseconds a single GBIF API request may take before it is aborted. Aborted attempts fall to the service's retry policy.

config.label: Sent as the User-Agent header on every GBIF API request
config.description: Sent as the User-Agent header on every GBIF API request. GBIF asks integrators to identify themselves with a contact URL or email. Unset or blank sends the server name, version, and repository URL.
